body.text: [AI-Applied] Fixed in auth.py (api_login, api_check_balance, api_transfer): replaced f-string SQL with parameterized queries using ? placeholders and bound params. Enforces T38 bind-variables across the sqlite auth surfaces. [QA batched/domain=injection]

[AI-Applied] Fixed in app.py (/upload_profile_picture_url): added SSRF guard - scheme allowlist (http/https), DNS resolution with private/loopback/link-local/reserved/multicast rejection, allow_redirects=False, verify=True (was verify=False). Library Format B (TA8521) intent translated to Python/Flask. [QA batched/domain=injection]

[AI-Documented] No dynamic code-loading surface in repo: AI scan found no eval()/exec()/__import__/importlib/pickle load of untrusted input across app.py, auth.py, ai_agent_deepseek.py, transaction_graphql.py, merchant_payments.py.

== Why Not Code-Fixable ==
Repository performs no runtime code/library loading from untrusted data; there is no insecure call site to remediate.

== Recommended Action ==
If dynamic import/plugin loading is added later, gate it behind an allowlist and integrity checks. [QA batched/domain=injection]

[AI-Documented] No SSTI surface: no render_template_string / jinja2.Template / string-built templates found; all rendering uses static render_template(...) files with Jinja2 autoescape.

== Why Not Code-Fixable ==
No user-controlled template string is compiled; SSTI is not reachable.

== Recommended Action ==
Never pass user input to render_template_string; keep autoescape enabled. [QA batched/domain=injection]

[AI-Documented] Primary API auth is JWT bearer tokens in the Authorization header (not ambient cookies) for the /api/* endpoints, so classic form-CSRF cannot forge those calls.

== Why Not Code-Fixable ==
Adding global CSRF token middleware would break the token-in-header JSON API; the cookie 'token' fallback in token_required is the real residual risk.

== Recommended Action ==
Remove the cookie token fallback or set SameSite=Strict; add Flask-WTF CSRFProtect for the HTML form routes. [QA batched/domain=injection]

[AI-Documented] Library recipe (Format B, TA8479) targets client-side JavaScript output escaping; server rendering uses Jinja2 autoescape. static/*.js should use safe DOM APIs.

== Why Not Code-Fixable ==
The recipe's escaping belongs in client JS; no unsafe server-side HTML interpolation found.

== Recommended Action ==
Use textContent/DOMPurify in static/merchant.js and static/dashboard.js instead of innerHTML with untrusted data. [QA batched/domain=injection]

[AI-Documented] DOM-based XSS is a client-side concern; server templates rely on Jinja2 autoescape and no |safe on untrusted data was found. Library Format B (TA8540).

== Why Not Code-Fixable ==
No server-side sink renders untrusted data unescaped into the DOM.

== Recommended Action ==
Sanitize any client-side DOM writes; avoid innerHTML with untrusted values. [QA batched/domain=injection]

[AI-Documented] No untrusted-data-driven server-side selection sink found (no open redirect from request params, no user-controlled template/handler dispatch).

== Why Not Code-Fixable ==
No dispatch/redirect target is chosen directly from untrusted input.

== Recommended Action ==
If added, map user input through a server-side allowlist rather than using it directly. [QA batched/domain=injection]
